text: Luggage. I do not have much luggage. One bag.
Cash. How much cash do I need for a month?
Budget. My budget for the trip is not very big.
Groceries. We buy groceries once a week.
Document. I need two documents for the visa.
Save. I am saving a little every month.
Cost. How much does the ticket cost?
Afford. I cannot afford a hotel, so I am staying with friends.
So how much is the flight?
Four thousand two hundred. And that is the cheap one.
How many documents do you need?
Two. Visa and insurance. Six hundred more, together.
That is a lot of money for two pieces of paper.
I know. I am saving a little every month, but it is not enough yet.
How much cash are you taking?
Not much. Two hundred for the first days, and then a card. Carrying too much cash makes me nervous.
And luggage?
One bag. If I take too many things I am going to spend the whole month carrying them.
How much does it cost?
I do not have much cash on me.
One bag is enough for a month.
I am saving a little every month.
I am not sure exactly — about four thousand, I think.

You asked how much I spent, so I looked at everything last night. Five weeks, and the total was about seven thousand reais. The flight was more than half of that. And here is where I lost control: the first week. I ate out every single day because I did not know where anything was, and that alone was almost a thousand. After that I bought groceries and cooked, and it dropped to nothing. So my advice, and take it seriously: take a little cash for the first two days, no more, and use a card after that. Everybody tells you to take a lot of cash. You do not need much.

Good afternoon, passengers. A reminder about luggage before you reach the desk. With this ticket you can take one bag in the cabin and one bag to check in, at no extra cost. The checked bag cannot be heavier than twenty-three kilos. If your bag is heavier, or if you have more bags, you pay at the desk, and I have to be honest with you: paying here costs a lot more than paying online. So if you already know you have too much luggage, do it on your phone now, in the queue. Thank you.
